owner_calls.question: The S.H.I.E.L.D. alias stage starts at Iron Man (where the full name is first spelled out), but the name S.H.I.E.L.D. is said earlier in this box's order: at the end of Agent Carter (One-Shot) Howard Stark says Peggy will run S.H.I.E.L.D., and Captain Marvel (1995) uses it throughout. Until Iron Man the row shows only 'The Strategic Scientific Reserve'. Should a S.H.I.E.L.D. stage start earlier?
options: Keep as is (stage at Iron Man, where the full name is first said)
Add a stage 'S.H.I.E.L.D.' at Agent Carter (One-Shot), keep the full-name stage at Iron Man
Move the S.H.I.E.L.D. stage to Agent Carter (One-Shot)
owner_calls.evidence: Agent Carter (One-Shot): Stark tells Flynn that Carter is to run S.H.I.E.L.D. with him (S.H.I.E.L.D. mentioned). Stage 1 itself is true from Iron Man on and is not early, so it passes; the question is whether stage 0 runs too long.
